verdict.rationale: Circle documents dedicated Agent Wallets that let AI agents hold and spend USDC/tokens with customizable spending controls and built-in compliance guardrails, backed by MPC/passkey key security so raw private keys are never exposed, plus gas sponsorship/policy features. This directly matches the story's requirements of programmatic wallet issuance, policy controls, and limits on agent fund movement. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that spending-policy enforcement actually works as documented, and finer detail on how 'scoped keys' are technically implemented beyond high-level policy language.
